summary: Calavo Growers filed an 8-K announcing that antitrust clearance from Mexico's COFECE has been obtained for its pending acquisition by Mission Produce. The all-stock merger is expected to close on May 28, 2026, with a joint proxy statement/prospectus mailed to shareholders around March 25, 2026. No price per share, premium, or financial terms are disclosed in this filing; it provides a regulatory update. Advisors are not named. The merger remains subject to continued satisfaction of all conditions. Watch for closing conditions and any last-minute regulatory or shareholder issues; risk-arb spread should narrow with clearance received.
